about: The pilot's five questions, restated by the Library, in the shape GE-Workshop's fresh_reader_run.mjs reads. The pilot of 2026-11-14 and 15 (method/double-diamond.md) kept the Composer's questions only as a paraphrase, so these five are the Library's restatement and NOT his words: he confirms or rewrites each before a run, and a changed file shows as a different sha256 on the run's sheet. See method/standing-measure.md. The rule and the bar are carried unchanged from the pilot and are his to confirm before every run.
rule: an answer counts 1 only if a session could act on it without coming back to ask him

questions.text: How can the refreshing of the library's pages be automated, and what exists to start from?
How do the different Auditoriums relate to each other as a progression of field scope?
What remedy exists for recurring presentation issues, and how is it enforced?
How does the library detect and handle pages whose content has become outdated?
How does an instance find the library's content, and what makes every instance search it before acting?
